cohort: Reproductive-aged women, particularly those with PCOS and/or obesity
finding: Obesity, commonly coexisting with PCOS, is a significant factor contributing to lower breastfeeding initiation and duration due to impaired lactogenesis, mechanical difficulties, psychological considerations, and increased likelihood of cesarean section.
mod_finding: Caesarean section, often associated with obesity, can contribute to reduced breastfeeding initiation and duration.
